_notes.brand / competitors: Replace with the client's domain, brand tokens and competitor names. The example values are placeholders.
_notes.hub_hosts: Hosts whose pages appear across unrelated SERPs and so never count as 1-shared join evidence. The four defaults are a neutral starting point; tune per category (add the review sites, forums or marketplaces that show up across your corpus). This list is a backstop, not the guard: the df cap is the guard.
_notes.meaning_tokens: Category terms whose loss or swap in a Google spell correction means the SERP answers a different question. Build them from the client's own keyword set; the values above are for the fictional espresso example only.
_notes.fetch_depth vs cluster.topn: Store 20, cluster on 10. Widening the clustering window inflates accidental overlap and breaks the T=2 calibration. Ranks 11-20 are used ONLY for near-miss refresh detection.
_notes.T: REVIEWER SIGN-OFF REQUIRED. An ABSOLUTE COUNT of shared URLs, never a ratio: a Jaccard or percentage form voids the whole T=2 + df<=5 calibration. T=3 under-merges question-form prompts because their SERPs rotate more than keyword SERPs.
_notes.one_shared_max_df: REVIEWER SIGN-OFF REQUIRED. A shared URL is evidence only if it is RARE. df = how many corpus SERPs contain it. The most shared URLs are usually category listicles, and cross-competitor bleed starts only a little above this cap. A domain-based hub list is NOT a substitute.
_notes.a_high_confidence_max_rank: REVIEWER SIGN-OFF REQUIRED. Counting a rank-10 hit like a rank-1 hit labels clusters 'high' that rest entirely on weak visibility.
_notes.centroid_only: Membership is tested against the CENTROID only, never against any member. Single-linkage looks like a cheap recall win and is not: a chain of individually weak links fuses two unrelated topics, and over-merging is the error only a human catches. Over-splitting is cheap and self-correcting; page assignment re-aggregates.
_notes.a_max_rank_considered: Brand hits worse than this rank do not fire Signal A; they set near_miss instead.
_notes.min_serp_urls: A SERP with fewer than this many DISTINCT urls carries no join signal; the prompt is held out of clustering and carried as REVIEW.
